## Devito

A symbolic finite-difference domain-specific language and just-in-time compiler.
Devito turns high-level symbolic equations into optimized parallel code for
CPUs and GPUs, supporting OpenMP, MPI, OpenACC, and heterogeneous systems.

::: {.tag-list}
<span>Symbolic APIs</span><span>Code generation</span><span>HPC</span>
:::

[GitHub](https://github.com/devitocodes/devito) ·
[Documentation](https://www.devitoproject.org/)
:::

::: {.software-feature-card}
<p class="project-label">Julia · Linear algebra · Inversion</p>

## JUDI

A matrix-free linear algebra framework for wave-equation-based inversion. JUDI
combines a concise Julia interface with Devito’s optimized numerical kernels
for scalable seismic and medical imaging workflows.

::: {.tag-list}
<span>Julia</span><span>Optimization</span><span>Imaging</span>
:::

[GitHub](https://github.com/slimgroup/JUDI.jl) ·
[Documentation](https://slimgroup.github.io/JUDI.jl/dev/)
:::
:::

## Research software built around real computational problems

::: {.software-card-grid}
::: {.software-card}
### JUDI4Cloud

Task-parallel wave-equation workloads on Azure Batch through a high-level
Julia interface.

[View project →](https://github.com/slimgroup/JUDI4Cloud.jl)
:::

::: {.software-card}
### TimeProbeSeismic

Low-memory adjoint-state imaging using randomized trace estimation and probing
methods.

[View project →](https://github.com/slimgroup/TimeProbeSeismic.jl)
:::

::: {.software-card}
### PhotoAcoustic.jl

Differentiable photoacoustic simulation and inversion for physics-based machine
learning workflows.

[View project →](https://github.com/slimgroup/PhotoAcoustic.jl)
:::

::: {.software-card}
### ImageGather

Surface and subsurface offset-gather tools for quality control of seismic
inverted models.

[View project →](https://github.com/slimgroup/ImageGather.jl)
:::

::: {.software-card}
### pysegy

Lazy, header-aware SEGY access compatible with local storage, cloud object
stores, `fsspec`, and Dask.

[View project →](https://github.com/mloubout/pysegy)
:::

::: {.software-card}
### XConv

Memory-efficient convolutional layers for PyTorch and Flux using randomized
gradient estimation.

[View project →](https://github.com/slimgroup/XConv.jl)
:::

::: {.software-card}
### SlimOptim

Julia implementations of optimization methods designed for costly
PDE-constrained problems.

[View project →](https://github.com/slimgroup/SlimOptim.jl)
:::

::: {.software-card}
### InvertibleNetworks.jl

Reversible neural-network components for memory-efficient training,
variational inference, and normalizing flows.

[View project →](https://github.com/slimgroup/InvertibleNetworks.jl)
:::
:::
:::

## Maintaining the foundations

My open-source work also includes continuous integration, release automation,
Julia registries, cloud deployment, community support, and contributions to
projects such as SymPy. Sustainable research software is as much about this
infrastructure as it is about algorithms.
:::
